product_overview: A single-page personal portfolio website that showcases the owner’s professional profile, technical skills, featured projects, and contact options. The site emphasizes clean React architecture, smooth scrolling interactions, and a polished visual presentation for recruiters and hiring managers.
core_goals: Browse the main portfolio sections from a single-page layout
Review the owner’s background and technical skill set
Inspect featured projects and follow external project links
Send a direct message through the contact form

features.name: Navigation
features.description: Allows visitors to move between the main sections of the portfolio and quickly return to key content areas on the single-page site.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click a navigation link to a section -> Scroll to the selected section
Navigate to / -> Scroll through the page -> Observe different portfolio sections appear in sequence
Navigate to / -> Use mobile navigation to choose a section -> Reach the selected section

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Lets visitors submit a direct message with their name, email, and message content.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in message -> Submit the contact form -> See a success notification
Navigate to / -> Leave one or more required fields empty or incomplete -> Submit the contact form -> See a validation or error notification

features.name: Navigation
features.description: Navigate to different sections of the portfolio (Home, About, Projects, Contact)

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Submit a message through the contact form using Web3Forms
user_interactions: Click Send Message button to submit
See success or error toast notification
